record.purpose: Evaluate the jcode fork's architecture, implementation quality, testing coverage, and user interface against the Agent Lab bootstrap profile criteria.
record.boundary: Source-level assessment of the fork as of commit d0a32f240. No deployed binary, runtime execution, or end-user observation was measured.

maturity.scenario_or_scoped_label: Source-level assessment: 85% assessed pass rate on 22 bootstrap criteria. Core operations pass; testing coverage and build reproducibility have gaps.

axes.basis: Clean crate boundaries, clear ownership, modular decomposition.
Core operations produce correct results; input validation present.
Significant coverage gaps; many tools lack dedicated tests.
SDKROOT workarounds are undocumented local paths blocking clean builds.
TUI fully keyboard-driven with focus management.
MCP tools discoverable; structured outputs; error categories distinguishable.
No cold-cache benchmarks; startup claims lack empirical backing.

maturity.value_evidence: No user outcome evidence collected. The assessment establishes baseline technical quality, not user value.

semantic_reviews.topic: Does the fork maintain upstream quality while extending capabilities?
semantic_reviews.assessment: The fork extends upstream with elicitation, swarm, and governance features while maintaining clean crate boundaries. Build passes after fixes. Testing gaps are the primary concern.
semantic_reviews.support: Cargo check passes with only warnings. Architecture follows upstream patterns. New modules integrate cleanly.
semantic_reviews.countercase: Testing gaps may hide regressions. SDKROOT workaround suggests build fragility.
semantic_reviews.discriminator: Run full test suite with coverage measurement to quantify actual gaps.
semantic_reviews.confidence_basis: Source-level inspection only; no runtime verification claimed.

semantic_reviews.topic: Is the elicitation overlay ready for production use?
semantic_reviews.assessment: The elicitation system compiles after build fixes but has no runtime test coverage. The overlay types and channel are well-structured but unverified at runtime.
semantic_reviews.support: Types defined, MCP tool present, TUI renderer implemented, channel wiring in place.
semantic_reviews.countercase: No integration test exercises the full elicitation flow from MCP call to TUI popup to response.
semantic_reviews.discriminator: End-to-end test: MCP tool call -> TUI overlay -> user response -> tool result.
semantic_reviews.confidence_basis: Source inspection confirms compilation; runtime behavior unverified.

record.next_action: Run full test suite with coverage measurement. Fix SDKROOT build workaround. Add integration tests for elicitation flow.
record.stop_condition: Pause further assessment expansion until core testing gaps (F-02) and build reproducibility (F-01) are addressed.
